title: The batch gate takes the next freed heavy-job slot ahead of merge trials and reruns only failed files after heat
description: With every heavy-job slot held by merge trials and a batch gate waiting, the first freed slot goes to the batch gate and no new merge trial starts before it; a batch gate whose run fails as slowed by heat reruns only its failed files on the next cycle and verifies when they pass.
